meta.name: Cloning The First Human
meta.description: Ever since February 1997, when genetic scientists first unveiled ‘Dolly’ the cloned sheep, has genetic engineering pushed towards the desire to clone and genetically modify human beings. Since then, cloned cattle, pigs, goats and mice have been produced amongst other things, fuelling the belief that humans can be next. But what are the problems with this manipulation?Cloning The First Humanfollows the latest research, which not only shows complications from an ethical position, but much more dangerous ones too…
